items.name: Edmonton Winter 2026

venue.name: [Strathcona Community Center](http://www.strathcona.ca/departments/facility-services/community-centre/)
venue.address: 401 Festival Ln, Sherwood Park, AB T8A 5T8

items.information:
Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, please arrive at least **15 minutes** before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in.

## First-Time Competitors:
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) for a basic overview of the rules.

## Notice of Filming and Photography:
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Weston-super-Mare Winter 2026
items.information:
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

**Spectators may attend for free!**

[![UKCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)

**PLEASE NOTE**: For this competition, there will be competitor limits for some events:
***- 6x6 and 7x7: first 40 to register***
***- 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded: first 16 to register***
Spaces are available on a first come first served basis. If you are amongst the first 40 (6x6/7x7) or first 16 (Multi-Blind) to register for those events, you will get a space in them. If you are not within the first people registered, your registration for that event will be removed after the close of registration. However we will be keeping waiting list for these specific events in the case of dropouts before registration closes. Please only consider registering for these events if you are certain you would like to compete in them.

items.name: Imagination Station A 2026

venue.name: [Imagination Station](https://www.imaginationstationtoledo.org/)
venue.details: Exploration Center - on the lower floor next to the cafeteria

items.information:
This competition is at the Imagination Station science center. Non-competing family members and spectators are **required to purchase general admission** to the science center to enter the competition. Competitors will pick up their lanyards at the front desk and will not need to purchase general admission.

Imagination Station opens at 10am - you will not be able to get in earlier.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbWlIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8843e254b05ca879fa0ab066c46e77b7920e76c8/Cubing%20Frontiers%20LLC%20Banner%20Transparent.png)

items.name: Georgia Quiet Championship 2026
items.information:
This competition has **only Blindfolded and Fewest Moves events**. If you are a first-time competitor and are interested in competing in regular events like 3x3, you may want to compete at the main [Georgia Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GeorgiaChampionship2026) in Dalton two weeks later instead.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE3NDgwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3df435f99b10bc79129b5dc96c89c341405a2965/Screenshot%202025-08-04%20at%2012.37.18%E2%80%AFPM.png)
All competitors who officially [declare their residency on their CubingUSA account](https://cubingusa.org/edit) in Georgia by **Tuesday, December 30, 2025 at 7:00 PM Eastern** will be eligible for Georgia Champion titles. Please note that you may be asked to verify your residency at the competition with identifying documentation if you achieve a Georgia Champion title. 

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GeorgiaChampionship2026#62006-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
